Recorded claim:
`/api/update-graphs` already returns `rebaseConflict`; `runGraphUpdate()` must call `openRebaseFailureDialog()` and report `Rebase paused for conflicts.`. Carry `graphIndex` into the rebase session so `/api/rebase/<session-id>/continue` refreshes the originating checkout. [Task 4]
